service_name: MC Shimla Citizen Charter -- Health Branch (Sanitation)
sub_service: Garbage/sanitation complaint via Municipal Corporation Shimla's Health Branch
problem_type: Uncollected garbage, street sweeping, public toilet issues
description: MC Shimla's own live Citizen Charter (shimlamc.hp.gov.in/CitizenCharter/Index) was fetched directly and reproduced verbatim. The Health Branch's function is explicitly stated: 'looking after the Health and Sanitation activities within the M.C. Shimla and provide the basic amenities i.e. door to door garbage collection, Street Sweeping, Operation and maintenance of public toilets, Issuing of Birth & Death certificates & operation of MC laboratory.' No SLA or dedicated department contact is given in the Charter itself -- the general MC Shimla contact applies.
procedure: Contact MC Shimla's general office (0177-2802771 / +91 177 2802776 / mcsml-hp@nic.in); the Citizen Charter names the Health Branch as responsible but gives no separate dedicated contact or online form for this branch specifically.
sla: SLA NOT FOUND -- the Citizen Charter explicitly states no SLA/timeframe is provided for the Health Branch.
source_organization: Municipal Corporation Shimla, Government of Himachal Pradesh
